description: This Java source file defines utility methods in the TypeUtils class for type conversions, class name manipulations, and descriptor generation, primarily used in Android APK analysis or processing tools.

classes.name: TypeUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting type representations to descriptors, handling class names, and parsing type strings for use in Android-related processing.

methods.name: typeToDescriptor
methods.description: Converts a human-readable type string into a JVM type descriptor, handling primitives, objects, and arrays.

methods.name: simpleClassNameToBinary
methods.description: Converts a simple class name to its binary form by replacing dots with dollar signs, suitable for inner classes.

methods.name: classNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the class name without package from a fully qualified binary class name.

methods.name: packageNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the package name from a fully qualified binary class name.

methods.name: ambiguousToBinaryName
methods.description: Normalizes ambiguous or incomplete class/type names into binary form, using an ApiList to identify known packages.
